none: PAS NLM-EC4675: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Genio Pop Rom issue of 307-316, Reece period 15. Very battered. Obverse description; Bullnecked bust laureate probably cuirassed right. Obverse inscription; [--]CONS[---]AVG. Reverse description: Genius standing left with right arm extended. Reverse inscription: [GENIO POP ROM]. Diameter: 21.0mm, Weight: 3.51gms, die axis: 6
